values.title: WebGL·GPU and the first image
values.goal: Connect the roles of the CPU and GPU and the rendering pipeline to the code for your first scene.

values.title: Scene·Camera·Renderer
values.goal: Distinguish the effects of camera position and field of view.

values.title: Geometry·Material·Mesh
values.goal: Experiment with shape and surface appearance separately.

values.title: Coordinate systems·Vector3·Matrix4
values.goal: Predict local/world coordinates and the order of transformations.

values.title: Light·Shadow·Texture
values.goal: Distinguish how light, shadows, and textures contribute to the image.

values.title: Raycaster·OrbitControls
values.goal: Turn a pointer position into a spatial ray and distinguish camera controls from selection.

values.title: Interactive scene review
values.goal: Integrate the camera, selection, resizing, and cleanup into one small scene.

values.title: Vertex·Fragment shader
values.goal: Distinguish the inputs and outputs of the two shader stages.

values.title: GLSL syntax and color
values.goal: Create colors using GLSL types and vector operations, and fix compilation errors.

values.title: Uniform·Attribute·Varying and time
values.goal: Explain the data paths between JavaScript and shaders, and create changes over time.

values.title: UV and Texture Sampling
values.goal: Distinguish surface UVs from screen coordinates and explain sampling.

values.title: Noise·Sin·Cos waves and distortion
values.goal: Explain the difference between periodic functions and noise, and experiment with waves one variable at a time.

values.title: ShaderMaterial integration
values.goal: Connect custom shader inputs, lifetimes, and errors to a Three.js scene.

values.title: Interactive shader review
values.goal: Complete and explain a small effect that connects UI input to uniforms.
